DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記入欄が、いっぱいになっていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: The entry space in your passbook is full.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい通帳にしたいです。ただ、この古い通帳には後で見たい入金記録があります。繰越しの時に古い方も返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通帳繰越しを希望し過去記録のある旧通帳返却を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a new passbook. However, this old one has deposit records I want to look at later. Can you return the old one too when replacing it?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a passbook replacement and ask for the old one with past records to be returned. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この手続きでは旧通帳もお返しします。新しい通帳だけに、前のページ全部が写るわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We return the old passbook in this procedure too. Not all of the previous pages are copied into the new passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 古い記録を見るには、この通帳も残す必要があるのですね。去年の入金を、自分の家計の確認に使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新冊へ過去全頁は移らず旧冊保管が必要と理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I need to keep this passbook too in order to see the old records. I want to use last year's deposits to check my household finances.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show you understand that not all old pages transfer to the new book and that you need to keep the old one. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お返しする旧通帳と新通帳を、分けて保管できます。見たい月は、今こちらで確認されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can store the old passbook we return separately from the new one. Have you checked the month you need here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 去年の十二月です。ページを見つけました。新しい通帳へ替えたら捨てるつもりでしたが、捨てずに保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 去年十二月頁を見つけ旧通帳廃棄をやめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: December last year. I have found the page. I was planning to throw the old passbook away after getting a new one, but I will keep it instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Find last December's page and say you will not discard the old passbook. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、繰越しのお手続きを確認します。お返しする際に二冊をお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will check the replacement procedure. Please check both books when we return them.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 去年の十二月ですね。月をメモしておきました。繰越しをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な記録の月を別のメモに控え繰越しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was December last year. I have noted the month. Please go ahead with the replacement.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the month of the records you need in a separate note and request the replacement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 繰越し後の新通帳と、旧通帳をお返しします。どちらもご本人の物かご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here are your new passbook after the replacement and your old one. Please check that both are yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二冊とも私の名前です。旧通帳の十二月のページも残っています。今後使う新通帳と、記録を見る旧通帳を分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二冊の本人名と旧頁残存を確認して現用と記録用を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both have my name. The December page is still in the old one too. I will keep the new one for current use separate from the old one for checking records.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check your name on both and that the old page remains, and separate the current-use book from the record book. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございました。それでは、二冊をお忘れにならないようお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-KARIYA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please remember to take both passbooks. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗浄の準備は、どこまで進みましたか。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-01.translation: How far have you got with the cleaning preparations?

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ブラシはそろいました。ただ、台の容器の札がぬれて読めません。これを使う前に、何が入っているか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗浄準備中の容器の札が読めず内容確認が必要と報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-02.translation: The brushes are all ready. However, the label on the container on the stand is wet and unreadable. I want to check what is inside before using it.
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the container label is unreadable during cleaning preparations and its contents need checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 札が読めない容器には触らないでください。ふたを開けたり、ほかへ移したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do not touch a container whose label cannot be read. Have you opened the lid or moved it elsewhere?

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。ふたを閉じたまま、元の台にあります。見た目だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容器を開けず移さず元の台にあると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have done neither. It is still on its original stand with the lid closed. I cannot judge from its appearance alone.
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have neither opened nor transferred anything and the container remains on its original stand. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者に容器を確認してもらいます。洗浄の開始も、それまで待ってください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will have the person in charge check the container. Please wait until then before starting the cleaning too.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 待ちます。隣の空のバケツまで同じ物だと思われないよう、問題の容器の位置を担当者に示します。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 開始を待ち問題の容器と隣のバケツを区別して示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait. I will show the person in charge where the problem container is so they do not mistake the empty bucket next to it for the same thing.
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Wait to start and point out the problem container separately from the adjacent bucket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者には私から連絡します。今朝の引継ぎで、この容器について聞きましたか。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will contact the person in charge. Did you hear anything about this container in this morning's handover?

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引継ぎではブラシの置き場だけ聞きました。容器の説明は受けていないので、知っているとは答えられません。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 引継ぎでは容器の説明を受けていないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the handover, I was only told where the brushes were. I received no explanation of the container, so I cannot say I know about it.
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that the container was not explained during the handover. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。担当者が来たら、札を読めなかったことと、説明を受けていないことを伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. When the person in charge arrives, tell them that you could not read the label and that you had not been given an explanation.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二点を伝えます。準備ができたと報告するのは、容器と作業内容を確認してからにします。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未読の札と未説明を担当者へ伝え確認後に準備完了を報告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them those two points. I will report that preparations are complete only after checking the container and the work to be done.
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the person in charge about the unreadable label and missing explanation, and report readiness after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認を優先してくれてありがとうございます。それでは、担当者を呼んできます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-AIC-OKAZAKI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for prioritizing checking. I will go and call the person in charge. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地図の展示について、ご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the map display?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この古い地図の線を家でも見たいです。横に同じ形の図がありますが、どちらも撮影できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古地図と横の図の撮影可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to look at the lines on this old map at home too. There is a diagram of the same shape beside it; may I photograph both?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can photograph the old map and the diagram beside it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ケース内の地図は貸出資料で撮影禁止です。横の複製は撮影できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The map in the case is on loan and may not be photographed. You may photograph the reproduction next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、ケースは撮らず、複製だけにします。複製は、元の地図をそのまま写した物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 複製だけを撮り元資料との関係を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will not photograph the case, only the reproduction. Is the reproduction an exact copy of the original map?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose to photograph only the reproduction and ask how it relates to the original. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この複製には、読みやすくするため現在の地名を青字で加えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Modern place names have been added to this reproduction in blue to make it easier to read.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 青い地名は昔から書かれていた字ではないのですね。写真に説明札も入れて、その違いを覚えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加された現在の青い地名と原文を区別し説明札も記録したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So the blue place names were not originally written on the old map. I would like to include the explanatory label in my photograph too so I remember that difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the added modern blue place names from the original text and say you also want to record the label. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 複製の説明札は撮影できます。貸出資料については、展示番号を控えていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may photograph the reproduction's explanatory label. For the item on loan, you may note its exhibit number.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 貸出資料の番号は十二ですね。ノートには十二と書き、元の地図の説明は今ここで読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 貸出資料の展示番号十二を控えて現地で説明を読む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The loaned item's number is twelve, right? I will write twelve in my notebook and read the original map's explanation here now.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Note the loaned exhibit's number twelve and read its explanation on site. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を撮る際は、隣のケースが画面に入らないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: When taking the photo, please keep the neighboring case out of the frame.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 複製の正面へ移動します。禁止のケースが入っていないことを確かめてから、一枚撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 禁止のケースが写らない位置へ移って撮影すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will move directly in front of the reproduction. I will check that the prohibited case is out of the frame and then take one photograph.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will move to a position that excludes the prohibited case before photographing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、地図の違いもご覧になりながら、見学をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Enjoy your visit while looking at the differences between the maps too.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお盆を持って、お席へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please take this tray to your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。持ち上げようとして器を傾け、汁を盆へこぼしました。まだこの台から動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 運ぶ前に器を傾け盆へ汁をこぼしたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sorry. As I tried to lift it, I tilted the bowl and spilled the broth onto the tray. I have not moved it from this counter yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you tilted the bowl and spilled broth onto the tray before carrying it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お盆はそのままにしてください。手や服に熱い汁はかかりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please leave the tray as it is. Did any hot broth get on your hands or clothes?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 手にも服にもかかっていません。盆の右側にたまっています。器の中には、麺と少しの汁が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 手や服への接触なしと盆と器の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: None got on my hands or clothes. It has collected on the right side of the tray. There are still noodles and a little broth in the bowl.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that none touched your hands or clothes, and describe the tray and bowl's condition. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで片づけます。お客様は右側を通らず、左へ一歩お寄りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will clean it up. Please do not pass on the right; move one step to the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左へ寄りました。自分で床を拭こうとしていましたが、お任せします。台の下にも落ちたか見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定位置へ移り自分で拭かず床も確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have moved left. I was going to wipe the floor myself, but I will leave it to you. Could you also check whether any fell under the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move to the indicated position, leave the wiping to the staff, and ask them to check the floor too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 床も確認します。同じうどんを追加料金なしで作り直します。注文はかけうどんの小でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the floor too. We will remake the same udon at no extra charge. Was your order a small plain udon in broth?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、かけうどんの小です。別の大きさに替えず、同じ物でお願いします。作り直していただけて助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 作り直す注文を小のかけうどんと確認し変更しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, a small plain udon in broth. Please make the same one rather than a different size. It helps a lot that you will remake it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the replacement order as small plain udon in broth, without changing it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新しいお盆にご用意しました。台と床の清掃も終わっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is ready on a new tray. We have also finished cleaning the counter and floor.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今度は両手で盆を持ち、器が傾いていないことを確かめてから席へ運びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 清掃完了と新しい盆を受け両手で安定を確かめて運ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. This time I will hold the tray with both hands, check that the bowl is not tilted, and then carry it to my seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the new tray after cleaning is complete and say you will carry it with both hands after checking it is stable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気をつけてお運びください。それでは、お食事をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please carry it carefully. Enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 確定の前で操作を止めていらっしゃいますね。どうされましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have stopped before confirming the transaction. What is the matter?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込もうとしました。案内には管理会社の名前がありますが、画面には個人の名前が出ています。先へ進めてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃の案内名と画面の個人名の相違を確定前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was trying to transfer my rent. The instructions show the management company's name, but an individual's name appears on the screen. I do not know whether I should proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before confirming, ask about the difference between the rent instruction's name and the individual's name on screen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ確定のボタンは押していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you not pressed the confirm button yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 押していません。支店と口座番号は紙から入れましたが、この名前の違いは初めて見ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未確定で紙の支店番号を入力したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have not. I entered the branch and account number from the paper, but this is the first time I have seen this name discrepancy.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not confirmed and entered the branch number from the paper. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内係では、家賃の指定先が正しいか判断できません。取引を確定せず、指定した相手へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: As information staff, we cannot judge whether the designated rent recipient is correct. Do not confirm the transaction; check with the party that specified the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いったん取り消したいです。紙に新しく書かれた電話番号ではなく、契約書にある管理会社の連絡先へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 取消しを希望し契約書の既知の連絡先へ照会すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to cancel for now. I will ask using the management company's contact details in my contract, rather than the new phone number written on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request cancellation and say you will check through the known contact details in your contract. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 取消しはこちらです。終わると最初の画面に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the cancel option. When it finishes, you will return to the initial screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 最初の画面へ戻りました。管理会社には、支店と番号だけでなく、表示された名前も伝えて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 初期画面へ戻り表示名も管理会社へ伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is back at the initial screen. When checking with the management company, I will give them the displayed name as well as the branch and account number.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have returned to the starting screen and will tell the management company the displayed name too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 違いを具体的に伝えてください。ここで同じ入力を続けるご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please explain the difference specifically. Do you intend to keep entering the same details here?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は確認できるまで入力しません。支払期限のことも管理会社へ相談して、宛先が分かってから手続きを考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先確認まで再入力せず期限も管理会社へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will not enter anything again until I can confirm it. I will also discuss the payment deadline with the management company and consider the procedure after the recipient is clear.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Do not reenter anything until the recipient is confirmed, and consult the management company about the deadline too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、資料をお忘れにならないようお持ちください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please remember to take your documents. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードのご利用について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about using the card?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友達と二人で乗ります。私のカードに千円あれば、一枚で二人とも改札を通れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一枚のカードと二人分残高で二人が乗れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I will travel together. If my card has a thousand yen, can we both pass through the ticket gates using that one card?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two people can travel with one card containing enough balance for both. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この改札では、一枚のカードを二人の乗車に使えません。お友達のカードもお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: At these gates, one card cannot be used for two people's journeys. Do you also have a card for your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友達は持っていません。残高を増やせば二人分になると思っていたので、先に聞いてよかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人はカード未所持でチャージ量との誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My friend does not have one. I thought adding more balance would cover two people, so I am glad I asked first.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your friend has no card and explain your misunderstanding about the amount topped up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お友達は別に切符を購入できます。お二人の行き先は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Your friend can buy a separate ticket. Are you both going to the same destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ駅です。友達は切符、私はカードにします。私の残高は百円なので、自分の乗車分を足したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ目的地で本人カードと友人切符を選び残高百円を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same station. My friend will use a ticket and I will use my card. My balance is a hundred yen, so I would like to add enough for my own journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose your own card and a ticket for your friend for the same destination, and state the hundred-yen balance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 片道運賃は一人三百円です。こちらでは千円からチャージできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The one-way fare is three hundred yen per person. Here, you can top up from a thousand yen.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分のカードへ千円を足します。友達の切符三百円は別の支払いとして、券売機で買ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人の千円チャージと友人の切符代三百円を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will add a thousand yen to my own card. My friend will buy the three-hundred-yen ticket at the ticket machine as a separate payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Separate your thousand-yen card top-up from your friend's three-hundred-yen ticket payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カードの残高は千百円になりました。切符の購入場所は左の券売機です。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your card balance is now eleven hundred yen. Tickets can be bought at the machine on the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 千百円を確認しました。友達が切符を買うまで待ち、それぞれ自分のカードと切符で改札へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 千百円を確認し友人を待って各自の媒体で改札へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the eleven hundred yen. I will wait until my friend buys a ticket, and then we will go to the gates using our own card and ticket respectively.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the eleven-hundred-yen balance, wait for your friend, and proceed to the gates with separate card and ticket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お二人でお気をつけて。よい旅をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care, both of you. Enjoy your journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で、書きにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any parts of the medical questionnaire that are difficult to fill in?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 「増悪する時」という言葉が読めません。右の膝が痛いのですが、この欄には何を書くのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 増悪の読みと問診欄の意味を右膝の痛みとともに尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot read the words “増悪する時.” My right knee hurts; what should I write in this field?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to read “増悪” and what the questionnaire field means, mentioning your right knee pain. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 「ぞうあく」は、症状が前より強くなることです。膝の痛みが強くなる時を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: “増悪” is read “zouaku” and means symptoms becoming stronger than before. Please tell us when your knee pain gets worse.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 階段を下りる時に強くなります。平らな道を歩く時も少し痛いですが、同じ強さではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 階段下降と平地歩行で痛みの強さが違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It gets worse when I go downstairs. It also hurts a little when I walk on level ground, but not as much.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the pain differs in intensity between going downstairs and walking on level ground. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その違いを書いてください。動くのをやめた後は、どうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write down that difference. What happens after you stop moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 座ってしばらく休むと弱くなります。ただ、完全になくなるわけではなく、立つ時にも痛みがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休むと弱まるが残り立つ時にも痛いと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It eases when I sit and rest for a while. However, it does not disappear completely, and it also hurts when I stand up.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say resting eases the pain but some remains, and standing up hurts too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 休んだ後の様子も診療担当へ伝えます。いつから続いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also tell the medical staff what happens after you rest. How long has this been going on?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: おとといの夕方からです。転んだ覚えはありませんが、原因は自分では分からないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: おととい夕方からで転倒記憶なし原因不明と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Since the evening before yesterday. I do not remember falling, but I do not know the cause myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that it started the evening before yesterday, you recall no fall, and you do not know the cause. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 原因が分からないことも、そのままで結構です。今も階段を使った後の痛みがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is fine to say you do not know the cause. Do you still have pain now after using the stairs?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は座っているので弱いです。階段を下りると強くなることと、休んでも少し残ることを、この欄へ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在の弱い痛みと悪化場面と残存を問診票へ書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It is mild now because I am sitting. I will write in this field that it gets worse going downstairs and that a little remains even after resting.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your current mild pain, the situation that worsens it, and the remaining pain in the questionnaire. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お書きになった内容を診療担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、待合席でお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will pass what you have written to the medical staff. Please wait in the waiting area. I hope you feel better soon.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類のお送りですね。ご希望の送り方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents, correct? Do you have a preferred shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 番号で追跡できる方法にしたいです。提出先からは「受領日の証明を添える」と言われました。番号があれば足りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 追跡番号が提出先の受領日証明に足りるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want a method I can track with a number. The recipient told me to “attach proof of the date of receipt.” Would a tracking number be enough?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a tracking number is sufficient for the recipient's required proof of receipt date. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な証明の種類は、提出先の指示も確認する必要があります。案内をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also need to check the recipient's instructions to know what kind of proof is required. Do you have the guidance with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このメールです。受領日とはありますが、画面の印刷でよいのか、別の書面なのか書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メールに証明の具体形式がないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the email. It says “date of receipt,” but does not say whether a printout of the screen is acceptable or a separate document is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the email does not specify the form of proof. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらでは、その提出先が受け付ける証明までは判断できません。どの形が必要か、お尋ねになれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We cannot determine here what proof that recipient will accept. Could you ask what form they require?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今から提出先へ連絡します。番号で調べた日付の印刷でよいか、別の書面が必要かを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面印刷か別書面か提出先へ質問すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will contact the recipient now. I will ask whether a printout of the date found using the tracking number is enough, or whether they need a separate document.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient whether a screen printout or a separate document is needed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認を終えてから、条件に合う送り方をご相談ください。今日の発送をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking, please ask us about a shipping method that meets the conditions. Would you like to send it today?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: できれば今日ですが、証明が足りなくなる方が困ります。確認が取れなければ、発送を急がず提出期限も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未確認で発送を急がず提出期限も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Today if possible, but insufficient proof would be a bigger problem. If I cannot get confirmation, I will not rush the shipment and will ask about the submission deadline too.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Do not rush shipping without confirmation, and check the submission deadline too. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、書類と封筒はいったんお返しします。お戻りの際は、確認した条件をお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will return the documents and envelope for now. When you come back, please tell us the conditions you confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 封筒を受け取りました。必要な証明の形と期限をメモしてから、あらためて発送の相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒を受領し証明形式と期限を記録して再相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the envelope back. I will note the required form of proof and deadline, then return to discuss sending it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the envelope, record the proof format and deadline, and say you will return for advice. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、ご確認の後にお待ちしております。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We look forward to seeing you after you have checked. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided what to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだです。落花生のアレルギーがあります。この串焼きのたれと、たれを入れる容器について確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 落花生アレルギーを伝えて串焼きのたれと容器を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not yet. I have a peanut allergy. I would like to check the sauce for these grilled skewers and the containers used for it.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your peanut allergy and ask about the grilled skewer sauce and its containers. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厨房へ確認します。材料だけでなく、容器の使い分けもご心配なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check with the kitchen. You are concerned about how containers are kept separate, as well as the ingredients, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。落花生を使う別の料理と同じ容器や道具を使うことがあるか、注文する前に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別料理との容器と道具の共用を注文前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Before ordering, I want to know whether they ever use the same containers or utensils as for other dishes containing peanuts.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Before ordering, ask about sharing containers and utensils with other dishes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厨房から、今日はたれの容器と道具を分けて対応することはできないと返事がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The kitchen has replied that today they cannot accommodate keeping the sauce containers and utensils separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。たれをかけないだけなら大丈夫、とは考えないようにします。串焼きの注文はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 分別対応不可を受けたれ抜きで安全と考えず注文しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I will not assume that simply leaving off the sauce makes it safe. I will not order the grilled skewers.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: After hearing separate handling is unavailable, do not assume sauce-free is safe, and decline to order. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの料理も同じ厨房で扱っています。対応できると確認できた料理は、今はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Other dishes are also handled in the same kitchen. At present, there are no dishes we have confirmed we can accommodate your needs for.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それでは、ほかの料理へ置き換えず、今回は食事を見送ります。まだ何も頼んでいませんが、席を離れてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他料理へ置き換えず食事を見送り退席を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will not switch to another dish and will skip the meal this time. We have not ordered anything yet; may we leave our seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline the meal without substituting other dishes and ask to leave. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご注文前ですので、お会計はありません。お連れ様もお帰りになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. As you have not ordered, there is no bill. Will your companion also be leaving?

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二人とも帰ります。友人にも店で対応できないと説明しました。確認してくださってありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人にも説明し二人で退席することと確認への感謝を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will both leave. I have also explained to my friend that the restaurant cannot accommodate this. Thank you for checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you have told your friend and both of you will leave, and thank the staff for checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望に添えず申し訳ありません。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-AIC-OKAZAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am sorry we could not meet your needs. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ハウスの作業へ移る前に、何か確認はありますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we move on to work in the greenhouse, is there anything you want to check?

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 長靴に畑の泥が付いています。このままハウスへ入ってよいか、先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 泥付き長靴でハウスへ入る前に扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is field mud on my rubber boots. I would like to ask first whether I can enter the greenhouse like this.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what to do with muddy boots before entering the greenhouse. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口の右に洗い場があります。そこで泥を落としてから、作業用の靴へ替えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a washing area to the right of the entrance. Wash the mud off there, then change into your work shoes.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 靴を替える場所も右ですか。ぬれた長靴を作業用の靴と同じ棚へ置かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 洗った長靴と作業靴の置場を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Is the changing area also on the right? I want to avoid putting wet boots on the same shelf as the work shoes.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check where to put the washed boots and the work shoes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 長靴は洗い場のラック、作業用の靴は入口の内側の棚です。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: The boots go on the rack in the washing area; work shoes go on the shelf inside the entrance.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に長靴を洗ってラックへ置きます。作業用の靴は、名前が書いてある自分の物を履きます。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長靴を洗い自己名の作業靴へ替えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will wash the boots first and put them on the rack. For work shoes, I will wear my own pair with my name on them.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wash your boots and change into the work shoes with your own name. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その後、手を洗ってから収穫の説明を聞きに来てください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: After that, wash your hands and come to hear the harvesting instructions.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手も洗います。外で使ったかごはまだ持っていますが、これをハウスへ運びますか。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手洗いを了承し外のかごの扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wash my hands too. I still have the basket I used outside; should I carry it into the greenhouse?
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Agree to wash your hands and ask what to do with the outside basket. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのかごは外の台へ戻してください。ハウスの中では別のかごを使います。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please return that basket to the stand outside. We use different baskets inside the greenhouse.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 外のかごを戻して、靴を履き替えます。手を洗い終わったら、入口で今日の収穫場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 外のかごを戻し履き替えと手洗い後に収穫場所を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return the outside basket and change my shoes. Once I have finished washing my hands, please tell me at the entrance where we will harvest today.
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will return the outside basket, change shoes, and ask where to harvest after washing your hands. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、準備が済んだら入口でお会いしましょう。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-AIC-TOYOHASHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us meet at the entrance once you are ready. Thank you for your work.
